description: AlphaFold DB (CC BY 4.0): prediction metadata for one UniProt accession — entry id, mean pLDDT, model/PAE/confidence file links. Keyless upstream. Costs 1 tool unit (0.1 from cache). Requires your agent key.

auth.description: Your agent key (awk_ + 32 hex) from aw_register. Required on stdio. Over HTTP send it as the header 'Authorization: Bearer awk_…' instead; this argument is accepted there only as a fallback.

name: aw_alphafold_get_prediction
